details: The U.S. Treasury's unexpected announcement to significantly increase its buybacks of long-term government bonds has injected liquidity into the financial markets and lowered long-term yields. This move has made riskier assets, including cryptocurrencies, more attractive to investors, triggering a substantial rally across the crypto market. Bitcoin, in particular, saw a significant surge, amplified by a short squeeze as bearish positions were forced to close.
title: US Treasury's Bond Buybacks Spark Crypto Rally

details: U.S. President Donald Trump met with crypto industry executives and urged Congress to swiftly pass the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act (CLARITY Act). This legislation aims to provide much-needed regulatory clarity for digital assets, defining oversight between the SEC and CFTC. Trump's renewed support for clearer crypto rules has been perceived as a significant positive for the industry, contributing to the recent market upturn.
title: Trump Endorses CLARITY Act, Boosting Crypto Regulatory Optimism

details: Despite recent rallies, the cryptocurrency market experienced a sharp plunge, with the total market capitalization dropping by approximately $108 billion in a short period. This led to significant liquidations, totaling $17.1 billion across 281,846 traders within 24 hours. Bitcoin, Ethereum, and XRP all saw declines, highlighting the market's sensitivity to leverage and rapid price movements, even amidst broader positive sentiment.
title: Crypto Market Plunges, $17.1 Billion Liquidated Amid Volatility
